# ledger_auth_methods (Data Source)

The sign-in methods the server offers. This is public information; the provider itself always authenticates with an API token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Public: which sign-in methods the server offers.
data "ledger_auth_methods" "methods" {}

output "oidc_enabled" {
  value = data.ledger_auth_methods.methods.oidc.enabled
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `oidc` (Attributes) Single sign-on. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oidc))
- `password` (Attributes) Password sign-in. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--password))
